The Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP) in Bochum is a research institute of the Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science. It conducts interdisciplinary research on the diverse aspects of IT security and data protection. The newly established and expanding institute will ultimately comprise 18 research groups and employ around 200 staff members and guests. The institute cooperates with the Faculty of Computer Science at Ruhr University Bochum. Bochum is one of the world’s leading research locations for cybersecurity and is home to Europe’s largest training center in this field as well as a vibrant start-up scene.

Starting immediately, we are seeking a

Project Coordinator - AI Competition (d/f/m), 50%

to support the organization, communication, and implementation of an AI competition. The competition combines cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity with the goal of advancing AI-based cybersecurity technologies. Teams from academia, start-ups, and industry will develop autonomous AI-based systems for identifying software vulnerabilities and assessing their exploitability.

The position is part-time (50%) and project-funded until the end of December 2028.

Competition Organization: Coordinate the organizational implementation of the tournament, including deadlines, participant communication, documentation, and organizational workflows.
Participant Management: Serve as an organizational point of contact for participating teams and prospective applicants; coordinate inquiries, registration processes, information materials, and communication throughout the competition.
Event Management: Plan and organize several events, in particular the qualification event and the final tournament. This includes venues, logistics, infrastructure, schedules, invitations, and coordination with external service providers.
Communication and Outreach: Develop and coordinate communication activities to increase awareness of the tournament among universities, research institutions, start-ups, companies, and the broader cybersecurity and AI communities. Identify and address relevant target groups and support targeted outreach activities to attract strong teams.
Website and Communication Materials: Coordinate and prepare content for the project website, newsletters, flyers, posters, social media, and other communication channels.
Public Relations: Coordinate media and public-relations activities around major project milestones and events in collaboration with MPI-SP’s communication structures and the project partners. Support communication and coordination with industry partners, policymakers, and other relevant stakeholders.
Project Coordination: Support meetings, schedules, documentation, reporting, and other organizational aspects of the project and ensure effective communication between the scientific team, project partners, participants, and external stakeholders.

A Master’s degree or comparable qualification, preferably in communication, event management, project management, science management, or a related field.
Experience in project coordination, event organization, communication, or public relations.
Excellent organizational and project-management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple activities and stakeholders simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.
The ability to communicate professionally with researchers, companies, public-sector organizations, and other external stakeholders.
A proactive, reliable, and solution-oriented working style.
Confidence in using standard digital communication and collaboration tools.

Experience in science communication, research organizations, technology competitions, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, or publicly funded research projects is advantageous but not required.

Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences
Doctoral Position: Gene Expression Regulation (f/m/x)

Uhlirova Lab | Institute for Genetics | CECAD

We are one of the largest and oldest universities in Europe and one of the most important employers in our region. Our broad range of subjects, the dynamic development of our main research areas and our central location in Cologne make us attractive for students and researchers from around the world. We offer a wide range of career opportunities in science, technology, and administration.

The Uhlirova lab (www.uni-koeln.de/inter-fak/cecad/uhlirova/) explores how stress-inducible signaling pathways control gene expression and influence tissue homeostasis and longevity. To tackle these questions, we combine the power of functional genetics in Drosophila and mouse models with cutting-edge molecular and cell biology, multi-omics approaches, advanced microscopy, and bioinformatics. We are looking for a highly motivated and curious doctoral candidate (f/m/x) to join our dynamic team. You will have the opportunity to lead your own project, contribute to collaborative research, and develop skills at the interface of genetics, molecular and cell biology, and systems-level analysis.

The University of Cologne promotes equal opportunities and diversity. Women will be considered preferentially in accordance with the Equal Opportunities Act of North Rhine-Westphalia (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz - LGG NRW). We also expressly welcome applications from all suitable candidates regardless of their gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, age, personal orientation and identity.

The position is available from immediately on a part-time basis (25,89 hours per week).The position is to be filled for three years. If the applicant meets the relevant wage requirements and personal qualifications, the salary is based on remuneration group 13 TV-L of the pay scale for the German public sector.

Please apply online without a photo with proof of the required
qualifications and the following documents:

A cover letter describing your motivation to join our research group and information on your career achievements (1 page max.)
Academic Curriculum Vitae, including your publication list and contact information for three references
Copies of your degree and qualification certificate

The reference number is Wiss2608-13. The application deadline is 27 September 2026.
For further inquiries, please contact Dr Esther Wollert (uhlirova-jobs@uni-koeln.de) and take a look at our FAQs. YOUR TASKS

To study the crosstalk between transcription and pre-mRNA splicing under physiological, stress, and disease conditions
To investigate mechanisms underlying spliceosome assembly and functional plasticity
To uncover what renders different transcripts, cells, and tissues sensitive to aberrant splicing
To investigate how spliceosome malfunction contributes to loss of tissue homeostasis, premature aging and diseases

Completed Master‘s degree or equivalent in Biology / Biochemistry/ Biophysics or related areas of Life Sciences
Strong background in genetics, molecular and cell biology is essential
Motivation, curiosity and creativity, and a strong ability to solve problems through critical analytical thinking
Proven ability to carry out an independent scientific project and unwavering commitment to high quality research
Hands-on experience in working with model organisms, preferably Drosophila and/or mouse and cell culture systems
Excellent communication skills, fluency in spoken and written English
Strong commitment to collaboration and teamwork

DESIRED ASSETS

Experience with protein purification and biomolecular interaction assays

Experience in quantitative image analysis and attention to detail

We at Yara are part of a global network, collaborating to profitably and responsibly solve some of the world's key challenges - resource scarcity, food insecurity and environmental change.

About the Unit

Within Yara, Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D leads the development and innovation of our crop nutrition solutions. We generate scientific and agronomic insights through laboratory, greenhouse, and field trials; translate these into product concepts and development projects, and support the wider organization with robust, evidence-based knowledge.

We are seeking a curious, proactive, and impact-driven scientist to advance our product development and innovation pipeline for new fertilizers and sustainable technologies that complement and strengthen Yara’s premium crop nutrition portfolio. This role is an integral member of the Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D team and reports to the R&D Lead - Premium Products and Organics.

Scientist - Crop Nutrition Products (f/m/d)

Location: Dülmen, NW, DE
Area of Expertise: Research and Technology Product Development
Job Type: Permanent
Work mode (place): On-site + Home office
Job Requisition ID: 24724

Design and coordinate R&D projects focused on developing high-efficiency phosphorous (P) and nitrogen (N) fertilizer product candidates.
Plan, coordinate and execute internal and external research on agronomic efficiency, nutrient release, soil quality and the environmental impact of fertilizer product candidates.
Develop and implement methods to evaluate the mode of action and performance of new crop nutrition products.
Perform screening and proof-of-concept testing for products and technologies originating from scouting activities and third-party collaborations.
Represent Yara at scientific and technical events, industry associations, and forums related to new fertilizer technologies.
Collaborate with the Premium Products and Organics R&D Team and the broader Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D organization by contributing to additional projects as needed.

Master’s degree plus relevant applied research or industry experience in crop nutrition, soil science, fertilizers, or related fields. A PhD in agronomy, soil science, crop science, plant nutrition, plant physiology or a related discipline is a plus.
Deep understanding of N and P chemistry in soils, nutrient dynamics, and mechanisms of nutrient uptake, transport and assimilation in plants.
Strong scientific grounding in crop nutrition, soil processes, and agronomy, gained through academic research or professional R&D experience.
Knowledge of soil and fertilizer chemistry and plant physiological processes, with the ability to apply these concepts to product development.
Fundamental knowledge of fertilizer products (e.g., soil- and foliar-applied fertilizers, liquids, water-soluble fertilizers, fertigation products, coatings, and seed treatments) and application techniques/equipment.
Hands-on experience conducting laboratory, greenhouse, and/or field experiments, and proficiency in experimental design, analysis and interpretation of complex datasets.
Ability to translate scientific insights into practical recommendations for Yara’s premium crop nutrition products.
Collaborative mindset and ability to work in multidisciplinary and international teams.
Fluency in English; German is a plus.
The position is full-time, permanent, and based in Duelmen, Germany.

jobs.occupation: Engineer - Engineering Ambulatory CTO SaaS, Framework (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You take end-to-end accountability for a large, distributed engineering organization that owns our ambulatory SaaS solutions and the shared framework modules used across all AIS DE products.

You co-define and drive the strategic product-technology roadmap for our cloud-based ambulatory portfolio in close collaboration with the executive leadership team.

You ensure that healthcare regulatory requirements-including medical device regulations, audits, and compliance-are rigorously embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.

You lead senior leaders and cross-functional teams, continuously increasing scalability, quality, AI maturity, and innovation velocity across products and platforms.

You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong executive-level stakeholder relationships, and position CGM as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.

Long-standing leadership experience at Director / VP / CTO level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardles...

Fluent German and fluent English, both in spoken communication and in writing, enabling you to work seamlessly in cross-functional, international teams and with German-speaking stakeholders.

Overview

The Generali Operations Service Platform (GOSP) supports the Generali Group in optimizing digital services and service quality. GOSP utilizes shared technology platforms for the group.
As a joint venture partner, Accenture supports transformation, innovation, and scaling. GOSP develops solutions for digitalization and the implementation of a cloud-centric model, encompassing areas such as IT infrastructure, procurement, security operations, and anti-money laundering.

That is the job

The Group Procurement unit manages the sourcing and purchasing of goods and services across the organization to ensure cost efficiency and supplier consistency. It centralizes procurement activities to leverage scale, optimize contracts, and support strategic business goals.

We're looking for a Senior Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) to lead sourcing initiatives within the Generali Group's Real Estate & Facility Management (RE&FM) domain. The position is limited until 30.06.2027. The role involves developing procurement strategies, managing supplier relationships, driving cost optimization, and ensuring compliance with procurement policies, while collaborating with internal stakeholders to support business objectives.

Key responsibilities of the role will include:

- Lead strategic sourcing initiatives in RE&FM within the Generali group
- Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business goals and compliance standards
- Manage supplier relationships, including negotiation, performance evaluation, and risk mitigation
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders (finance, legal, operations, etc) to ensure procurement alignment with project needs
- Drive cost optimization and value creation through market intelligence and benchmarking
- Support contract management and ensure adherence to procurement policies and procedures
- Monitor procurement KPIs and prepare regular reporting for senior stakeholders

Profile

- University degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Minimum 2 years of experience in strategic procurement, preferably in an international environment
- Proven experience managing sourcing activities for real estate services, facility operations, maintenance, and capital projects
- Familiarity with vendor management in RE&FM categories such as cleaning, security, catering, HVAC, and energy services
- Proficient in procurement platforms (e.g., SAP Ariba, Ivalua)
- Strong knowledge of strategic sourcing, contract negotiation, and supplier performance management
- Familiarity with risk assessment and compliance frameworks
- Understanding of RE&FM-specific KPIs, SLAs, and sustainability metrics
- Experience with lease administration, property lifecycle cost analysis, and FM service benchmarking
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
-  Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities as well as high attention to detail and ability to deliver under tight deadlines
- Proactive, adaptable, solution-oriented mindset and team player with cross-functional collaboration experience
-  Ability to influence internal clients and drive cost optimization without compromising service quality
- Fluent in English (written and spoken) / German, Czech, or other European language is a plus

Business Support & Enhancement

- Act as the key interface between business and technical teams
- Analyze business requirements, prioritize the product backlog, and translate them into technical specifications or user stories
- Manage enhancements, configurations, and system optimizations to support evolving business needs and maximize business value

Project & Vendor Management

- Lead or contribute to digitalization and automation initiatives leveraging Robotron eSales
- Take ownership of vendor management by effectively managing relationships with Robotron and other external service providers to ensure SLA fulfillment and timely feature delivery
- Support implementation projects, testing, and release cycles

Quality, Security & Compliance

- Ensure data quality, system documentation, and audit readiness
- Promote adherence to IT security, data protection, and compliance standards

Your profile:

- Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience
- Several years of proven experience as a Product Owner or Application Manager specifically with Robotron eSalesGood understanding of German and/or European energy market processes (e.g., billing, EDM, market communication)
- Hands-on knowledge of: - SQL databases
- Interfaces/API concepts (EDIFACT, AS4, REST)
- Application lifecycle management
- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a proactive, customer-oriented approach
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to effectively align with business leaders and external vendors
- Fluent in German and English

What We Offer You:

- **EXCITING EXTRAS:** Discounts, e-bikes, services, and technology from leading providers via our ENGIE platform.

Process Operator (f/m/d)

Place of work: Production site, near Chemnitz, Germany
Start date: ASAP
Contract type: Full-time

About us

We’re on a mission to revolutionize how the world produces protein and we’re just getting started.

Pacifico is a Leipzig-based biotech company producing the world’s most cost-competitive texturized protein through fermentation. Our technology makes sustainable, high-quality protein cheaper than conventional meat production – not just better for the planet, but better for you.

Our production site near Chemnitz is where science meets scale: industrial fermentation systems, food-grade processing lines, and a team that moves fast. We’re now looking for a Process Operator (f/m/d) to support the day-to-day facility operations at our production site.

The role

In this role, you will support the operations of our fermentation facility and all related processing steps. You will work closely with a Senior Process Lead and will be trained on our equipment, processes, and quality standards.

The role is strongly hands-on and operational, with a focus on running equipment, preparing materials, and supporting production. Working hours are initially within typical daytime working hours; as production scales, openness to late and occasional weekend shifts is valued.

Your main tasks

- Preparation of fermentation media (weighing, mixing, heating, handling raw materials)
- Operating fermentation tanks and auxiliary equipment
- Supporting downstream processing (emptying tanks, handling and processing biomass)
- Operating our food processing line and its associated equipment
- Monitoring basic process parameters (e.g. temperature, time, filling levels)
- Cleaning and sanitising equipment (CIP systems and manual cleaning)
- Maintaining cleanliness, order, and safety in the facility
- Documenting basic production activities and flagging issues when they arise

Your profile

- Practical experience in food & beverage or similar manufacturing environments
- Comfortable working in a production setting with physical tasks and machinery
- Careful, reliable, and quality-oriented working style
- Interest in food production and fermentation processes
- Ability to work well in a small team and communicate clearly on the shop floor
- Basic working knowledge of English

Nice to have

- Experience in a brewery, dairy or fermentation-based production
- Technical or vocational training in a relevant field
- Familiarity with hygiene standards and food safety practices
- Experience with CIP systems or industrial cleaning routines
- Basic working knowledge of German

What we offer

- A full-time role with clear responsibilities and growth opportunities
- 28 days of paid holiday per year
- Subsidy for the Germany Ticket (“Deutschland-Ticket”)
- Hands-on training and close collaboration with experienced colleagues

How to apply

A short CV/brief overview of your previous work experience is sufficient.
